paragraphs: California Gold Nutrition® L-Glutamine + L-Leucine, 1,000 mg combines AjiPure® Quality L-Glutamine and L-Leucine, in a 1:1 ratio, ideal for individuals looking to support muscle performance, recovery, and strength.* These premium L-form amino acids support muscle endurance, muscle protein synthesis, and overall muscle health.*

L-Glutamine is a conditionally essential amino acid and the most abundant in human muscle tissue, aiding in muscle repair and boosting immune function.* L-Leucine, an essential Branched Chain Amino Acid (BCAA) , stimulates the mTOR pathway to promote muscle protein synthesis and enhance strength performance.* Together, these amino acids are ideal for improving muscle endurance, building lean muscle mass, and accelerating recovery after exercise.*

L-Glutamine & L-Leucine are sourced exclusively from AjiPure® and are produced through a patented Ferment-AjiPure® Technology, ensuring pharmaceutical-grade purity without any animal products, making it suitable for vegetarians and vegans.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 2 capsules daily, with or without food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Consult with a licensed physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
